notes:
## Changes

- **Lighter playback for older phones and tablets.** If a video stops or the page crashes a few seconds into playing (seen on an older Android tablet), switch on **Lighter playback on this device** under the video. The PC then plays every scene as a smaller 720p version it makes as it plays, which older devices can handle. It's remembered on each device, so your other phones still get the full-quality files. It needs **Also play everything else** chosen in Settings › Phone and tablet, and works the PC hard while a scene plays.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
